summary: Refine existing Home page only with a cohesive dark-luxury navy–gold aesthetic and subtle premium motion; no routing/layout/content/component hierarchy changes; remove all white/light sections.
architectural_notes: Scope constraint: Apply changes ONLY to the existing Home page; do NOT modify routing, other pages, component hierarchy, section names, or content/text.
Design system constraint: Remove all white/light backgrounds on Home; use layered gradients (#0b1622 → #0f1f2f → #0b1622) with smooth blending and no hard breaks.
Motion constraint: Luxury/subtle animations only (fade + soft rise, slow easing); avoid flashy animations/particles/large movements.
known_issues: Home page has white/light backgrounds and footer areas that break the dark theme; hero text readability is insufficient (needs contrast/overlay).

existing_features.title: Apply visual + motion refinements ONLY to the existing Home page and its home-route-specific styling, without changing routing, layout/structure, component hierarchy, or any text/content. Do not modify the visual appearance of any non-Home pages.

Remove all white/light backgrounds from the Home page by implementing a cohesive layered deep-navy background system with smooth blending and no hard breaks, matching: Top #0b1622, Middle #0f1f2f, Lower #0b1622.

Upgrade the Home Hero section for readability and depth while keeping the current hero image. Add a cinematic dark overlay at rgba(0,0,0,0.55), increase headline contrast to #f5f2ea, add a soft text shadow, and keep the parallax effect very subtle (respect prefers-reduced-motion).

Adjust Home hero entrance animations to match the specified luxury timing: Headline fade + rise over 900ms ease-out; subtext uses a 150ms delay; buttons use a 300ms delay. Keep motion subtle (no large movement), and disable animations under prefers-reduced-motion.

Refine the Home Crafting Quality section to remove any light background and continue the deep-navy gradient. Constrain the text container width to 680px, increase vertical padding, add a thin centered gold divider line with animated expansion, and apply scroll reveal (fade + ~30px rise) while staying subtle. Optional: very subtle radial glow behind the heading.

Update Home Feature Cards to a premium glass style with the exact richer card background and hover behavior: base background rgba(20,30,45,0.65), backdrop blur 12px, border 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.15). On hover: slight lift (translateY -6px), brighter gold border, and a subtle glow shadow. Entrance animation must be staggered with 0.15s delay increments between cards and remain subtle; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

Upgrade the Home CTA section and the divider between Feature Cards and CTA: add a subtle thin horizontal gold glow line centered between sections (very thin, low opacity), keep CTA background dark, add a soft radial warm glow behind the CTA heading, and set CTA button gold to #c9a14a with hover glow + scale 1.03 and smooth 250ms transition.

Make the Home footer fully dark luxury (no white) while ensuring non-Home footers are unchanged: set Home footer background to #08121a (or current home-footer-dark token updated to match), add top border 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.15), set body text to #b8b8b8, and keep headings in soft gold. Footer must feel like a continuation of the Home page (no abrupt light break).

new_feature_requests.summary: Home page-only dark-luxury visual + motion refinement: layered deep navy gradients, improved hero readability (overlay/contrast), premium glass feature cards, upgraded CTA and footer, and subtle fade/rise animations; preserve existing layout and content

projectName: Home page-only dark luxury refinement (no layout/content changes)
